identity.name: Node.js Package Communication to External Host
identity.summary: An attacker uses a Node.js package to initiate outbound communication to an external host, triggering an ABIOC for uncommon package behavior. Cortex should detect the process start and network connect
identity.description: An attacker uses a Node.js package to initiate outbound communication to an external host, triggering an ABIOC for uncommon package behavior. Cortex should detect the process start and network connection.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Node.js package initiated communication
biocs.description: Detection of Node.js process starting and connecting to external host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'node'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'

abiocs.name: Uncommon Node.js package initiated communication
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where Node.js package initiates communication to external host
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'node'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
abiocs.causality_anchor: node process start with outbound connection

xql_queries.name: Node.js outbound communication
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name = 'node'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
